messages.content: Independent enterprise release-risk reviewer for exact SHA c29dd79cac99e15371d8344868f62a8b1b670112. P means PASS and F means FAIL. If there is no concrete unresolved material defect, output v=P and f=NONE. If and only if there is a concrete unresolved material defect, output v=F and f=MATERIAL_FINDINGS. Output schema JSON only.

Exact V8 evidence. Product adds private first-run guidance and clearer brand/tenant UX. New GET/POST /me/onboarding uses the existing authenticated API boundary; POST inherits same-origin/CSRF checks. The service derives user ID from the authenticated actor and rejects caller-supplied fields. Onboarding tenant summary is built only from resolved memberships and exposes safe brand facts, not runtime/browser identities. Repository adds backward-compatible user_onboarding state. Create-tenant server authority remains unchanged and still requires can_create_tenants; UI merely stops advertising the CTA to unauthorized users. Existing active actors are recognized RETURNING so rollout does not force-onboard them. New users with no/unprepared brand can enter a private guide; the guide is dismissible and manually reachable later. New tenant lands on /workspace/:id/start, which uses the existing authoritative journey endpoint and no fake percentage. Critic found two issues and both are fixed: stale multi-account browser login assumptions and action feedback hidden when a supported change immediately re-entered Creation Room. Exact evidence: full suite 188 discovered / 187 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; focused onboarding+Creation Room 16/16; typecheck/build PASS; contracts 13/13; audit clean; generic browser, FIRMES non-test, source-recovery, scene-generation and Ease E2Es all PASS on clean exact SHA. Detached independent worktree: 59/59 targeted plus typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS. Runtime 1481 files, 0 forbidden entries, 0 external symlinks. Auth implementation, provider execution, approval/release authority, dependencies, Docker/Compose, deployment and trust-root code are unchanged.
